capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Green Car Reports: Large Pack 109.4 kWh usable. Conflicts: Rivian support-page snippet 108.5; 2027 press (autoevolution) calls the Large/Premium pack 105.5 kWh. Mapping note: no page names a Gen 2 "Large Plus" pack; treated as the Large pack (109.4 kWh).

chemistry.notes: Green Car Reports: Large keeps NCA 2170 cells (autoevolution says NMC).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Gen 1 EPA voltage window 216-459 V (400 V class); no page states a move to 800 V for the Gen 2 R1, and the Gen 2 DC peak (200-220 kW) is in the Gen 1 range.

preconditioning.notes: Navigation-triggered battery preconditioning plus manual battery preconditioning (no longer forced to use navigation) added by software 2025.18 for Gen 1 and Gen 2 (current state for owners). Before 2025.18 it was navigation-only.

dc_max_kw.notes: Green Car Reports: peak for Large and Max remains 220 kW (software 2025.18 note says Large peak rises to 215 kW; independent Max tests 207-221 kW).

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 2025 Gen 2 R1 is 11.5 kW (Green Car Reports: 48 amps, 11.5 kw); 2026 assumed unchanged.
